title: Train a tiny transformer to reverse digit strings
brief: Build masked attention, positions, pre-norm blocks, an answer-only loss, and a training loop from torch tensors, then check the model on strings it has never seen.
hints: The mask must have -inf above the diagonal and 0 elsewhere, and it is added to the scores before the softmax. Build it with a boolean triu and masked assignment, because multiplying by -inf gives NaN at the zeros.
In attention, view (B, T, H, d_head) and transpose(1, 2) to get (B, H, T, d_head). Undo with transpose(1, 2) and reshape(B, T, d) before multiplying by Wo.
Pre-norm means x = x + attention(layer_norm(x)), then x = x + feed_forward(layer_norm(x)). Never wrap the residual stream itself in a norm.
answer_loss: per_token_loss gives (B, T). Multiply by the mask as a float and divide the sum by mask.sum(). Count weights with V*d + L*(4*d*d + 3*d*f + 4*d) + 2*d.
